Messages.Author: niko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
Corrupt Construction, Ally, 1 pool, Vicissitude, C , [Third]
Ghoul with 1 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed. [vic] When the Construction
enters play, you may remove from the game any number of ally, retainer,
or vampire cards from your ash heap or hand. The Construction gains one
life for each card removed in that way. The Construction gets +1
strength for each life counter it has. During your untap phase, the
Construction burns 1 life. [VIC] As above, and the Construction has an
additional life.

Do I have to announce how many allies, retainers, vampire cards I want
to burn when I announce the action, or can I just start removing them
and then add an extra one if I replace another retainer/ally when
discarding one from my hand?

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:


No and Yes.

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Ah. Right.
You can use the ones drawn to replace the Construction and any
pre-action-resolution cards played (stealth, &c.) But not ones drawn to replace
other ones removed from your hand.
